title: Remove the compatibility shim for log_task_event AwsEcsExecutor and AwsBatchExecutor
body:
Now that AWS provider has min airflow version 2.11 we can remove this compat shim.

https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/providers/amazon/pyproject.toml#L61

files.patch:
@@ -22,7 +22,6 @@
 import time
 from collections import deque
 from collections.abc import Sequence
-from contextlib import suppress
 from copy import deepcopy
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
 
@@ -508,12 +507,3 @@ def try_adopt_task_instances(self, tis: Sequence[TaskInstance]) -> Sequence[Task
 
             not_adopted_tis = [ti for ti in tis if ti not in adopted_tis]
             return not_adopted_tis
-
-    def log_task_event(self, *, event: str, extra: str, ti_key: TaskInstanceKey):
-        # TODO: remove this method when min_airflow_version is set to higher than 2.10.0
-        with suppress(AttributeError):
-            super().log_task_event(
-                event=event,
-                extra=extra,
-                ti_key=ti_key,
-            )

@@ -26,7 +26,6 @@
 import time
 from collections import defaultdict, deque
 from collections.abc import Sequence
-from contextlib import suppress
 from copy import deepcopy
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
 
@@ -606,12 +605,3 @@ def try_adopt_task_instances(self, tis: Sequence[TaskInstance]) -> Sequence[Task
 
             not_adopted_tis = [ti for ti in tis if ti not in adopted_tis]
             return not_adopted_tis
-
-    def log_task_event(self, *, event: str, extra: str, ti_key: TaskInstanceKey):
-        # TODO: remove this method when min_airflow_version is set to higher than 2.10.0
-        with suppress(AttributeError):
-            super().log_task_event(
-                event=event,
-                extra=extra,
-                ti_key=ti_key,
-            )
